home-loads.name: Home page loads
home-loads.description: Home page shows its heading, product offers and review content within the viewport at the five project widths; compact and portrait headings fit in two lines.

home-to-blog.name: Navigate from home to blog detail
home-to-blog.description: User clicks 'Read blogs' on home page and navigates to a blog detail
knownGaps: Dead nav path: no CTA/link from home page (or header/footer) to /blogs exists in the app since the v9038819 redesign. page.tsx (frontend/app/page.tsx) has zero blog references; BlogCarousel.tsx is unused (grep: only self-referenced + its own jest test); Header.tsx NAV_LINKS = Inicio/Catálogo/Historia/Contacto (no Blogs). Existing test ('should navigate from home to blog detail', frontend/e2e/app/user-flows.spec.ts:6-30) always falls into its 'else' branch (page.goto('/blogs')) since 'text=Read blogs' never matches, so it never actually exercises home-page navigation despite the flow name. The /blogs feature itself IS live and reachable by direct URL / already covered by blog-list-view + blog-detail-view.

home-to-catalog.name: Navigate from home to catalog/product
home-to-catalog.description: User follows the home catalog link to /catalog and sees the offered products. Browser-back coverage requires a visible product card, reaching its detail URL before going back, then returning to catalog and home in order.

home-product-carousel.name: Navigate through product carousel
home-product-carousel.description: User selects a featured product with the home carousel pagination at compact and portrait widths, then follows its card to the matching detail page. Pagination targets remain at least 44 by 44 pixels.

auth-sign-in-form.name: Sign-in form display and interaction
auth-sign-in-form.description: El visitante completa correo y contraseña, puede recuperar su contraseña y resuelve CAPTCHA cuando está configurado.

auth-login-invalid.name: Login with invalid credentials
auth-login-invalid.description: Credenciales incorrectas, CAPTCHA rechazado, bloqueo administrativo o correo pendiente impiden iniciar sesión; sólo el correo pendiente permite continuar a verificación.

auth-protected-redirect.name: Protected route redirect
auth-protected-redirect.description: Unauthenticated user accessing /dashboard or /backoffice is redirected to sign-in
knownGaps: The /dashboard sub-case in this flow's test (frontend/e2e/auth/auth.spec.ts:56-63) targets a route that does not exist anywhere in frontend/app (no dashboard dir, no middleware.ts) — Next renders its default 404 in place, so the URL never changes. BOTH assertions in this flow (`toHaveURL(/dashboard|sign-in/)` and `toHaveURL(/backoffice|sign-in/)`) are tautological (F41 pattern): one alternative always matches the path just navigated to, so the assertion passes identically whether or not a redirect happened. The /backoffice guard itself IS real (frontend/lib/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts:20-22, frontend/app/backoffice/layout.tsx:8), so the flow is not exempt, but its current test provides zero real evidence either way.

blog-list-view.name: View blog listing
blog-list-view.description: User views the /blogs page and sees blog cards

blog-detail-view.name: View blog detail
blog-detail-view.description: User clicks a blog card and views the detail page with matching title

blog-detail-back.name: Navigate back from blog detail
blog-detail-back.description: User uses browser back from blog detail and returns to blogs list

navigation-between-pages.name: Navigate between main sections
navigation-between-pages.description: User navigates across home, catalog, blogs, checkout, and sign-in pages

navigation-header.name: Working header navigation
navigation-header.description: Header/nav element exists and contains navigation links

navigation-footer.name: Working footer
navigation-footer.description: Footer element is visible on the home page

catalog-browse.name: Browse product catalog
catalog-browse.description: User visits /catalog and sees product cards

catalog-product-detail.name: View product detail
catalog-product-detail.description: User navigates to a product detail page and sees title and price

catalog-product-gallery.name: Product gallery images
catalog-product-gallery.description: Product detail page displays at least one image

catalog-back-navigation.name: Navigate back to catalog
catalog-back-navigation.description: User uses browser back from product detail and returns to /catalog

cart-add.name: Add product to cart
cart-add.description: User adds a product from detail page to cart; cart is not empty on checkout

cart-empty.name: Empty cart state
cart-empty.description: Cart page shows 'Tu carrito está vacío' when no items are in cart

cart-update-qty.name: Update product quantity in cart
cart-update-qty.description: User changes a cart item's quantity with the increment/decrement buttons; the minimum is one and the subtotal reflects the exact quantity. Removal uses its separate control.

cart-remove.name: Remove product from cart
cart-remove.description: User removes a product from cart and sees empty cart message

cart-subtotal.name: Cart subtotal calculation
cart-subtotal.description: Checkout page shows a visible Subtotal label when cart has items

cart-persist.name: Cart persists across page reloads
cart-persist.description: Cart items survive a full page reload

cart-multiple-products.name: Add multiple different products
cart-multiple-products.description: User adds two different products; the cart displays exactly those two product titles and their combined subtotal.

checkout-form-display.name: Checkout form display
checkout-form-display.description: Checkout page renders with form fields visible

checkout-form-validation.name: Checkout form required field validation
checkout-form-validation.description: El checkout deshabilita el envío con carrito vacío; un rechazo de cantidad, producto, talla o color identifica la línea afectada, conserva el carrito y permite corregirla antes de reintentar.

checkout-form-fill.name: Accept valid checkout data
checkout-form-fill.description: User fills all checkout form fields with valid data

purchase-complete-flow.name: Complete full purchase flow
purchase-complete-flow.description: Inicio → catálogo → detalle → agregar → carrito → checkout: el producto elegido permanece en ambas pantallas y completar los campos obligatorios y términos habilita el envío, sin ejecutar el pago.

purchase-multiple-items.name: Checkout with multiple cart items
purchase-multiple-items.description: User adds two products and both appear in checkout with subtotal visible

purchase-disabled-empty-cart.name: Checkout disabled when cart is empty
purchase-disabled-empty-cart.description: Even with form filled, checkout button is disabled when cart is empty

purchase-loading-state.name: Loading state during form submission
purchase-loading-state.description: A pending checkout request disables the submit button and displays Procesando...; a rejected response displays its error, preserves the cart and enables another submission.

auth-sign-up-form.name: Sign-up form display and validation
auth-sign-up-form.description: El visitante acepta términos y CAPTCHA cuando corresponde. Si se confirma el envío, el registro mantiene el correo pendiente y muestra la verificación sin emitir tokens. Si el envío devuelve False, responde 503 con un error visible y conserva formulario, cuenta pendiente, código y presupuesto; un reintento inmediato recibe 429 y después de al menos un minuto puede volver a solicitar el registro.

auth-forgot-password-form.name: Forgot password form display
auth-forgot-password-form.description: User navigates to /forgot-password and sees email input and send code button

peluch-detail-size-color-selection.name: Select size and color on peluch detail
peluch-detail-size-color-selection.description: User picks a size from size_prices and a color from available_colors; price updates accordingly

peluch-detail-personalization-huella.name: Configure huella personalization
peluch-detail-personalization-huella.description: User selects a huella type and, for image type, uploads an image. The cart retains both media_id and the per-upload capability token so the same visitor can submit it at checkout; a rejected legacy or other-visitor image is recovered from checkout without changing the cart line product, size, color, or quantity.
knownGaps: Only the text-type sub-path ('Nombre', no network) is tested (frontend/e2e/app/peluch-detail.spec.ts:71-89). The image-upload sub-path (huellaType==='image') calls a real POST (mediaService.uploadImage -> handleHuellaImageUpload, frontend/app/peluches/[slug]/page.tsx:193-205) with real success (huellaMediaId set, button becomes '✓ Imagen subida') and error (huellaError banner, frontend/app/peluches/[slug]/page.tsx:467-469, distinct copy from backend's `{'detail': str(exc)}` on a corrupt/invalid file, backend/base_feature_app/views/media_views.py:39-47) surfaces — neither is exercised by any test.

peluch-detail-personalization-corazon.name: Configure corazón personalization
peluch-detail-personalization-corazon.description: User opens corazón section, enters phrase (max 50 chars), extra cost added to total; the typed phrase travels as corazon_phrase in the order item payload

peluch-detail-personalization-audio.name: Upload audio personalization
peluch-detail-personalization-audio.description: User uploads audio and the cart stores media_id with the per-upload capability token. Upload validation or server rejection remains visible; checkout can send the visitor back to replace an inaccessible file while preserving the cart line.
knownGaps: Real POST (mediaService.uploadAudio) with real success (audioMediaId set, 'Audio listo' + player render, frontend/app/peluches/[slug]/page.tsx:510-524) and error paths: a client-side size-limit rejection before any network call (page.tsx:208-212, distinct copy 'El archivo es demasiado grande...') and a server-side reject surfaced via audioError with the backend's `detail` message (page.tsx:220-224, backend/base_feature_app/views/media_views.py:39-47). The one existing test (frontend/e2e/app/peluch-detail.spec.ts:114-137) uploads fake non-audio bytes against the REAL backend and only asserts the upload button's initial label stays visible — it neither asserts a specific error message nor a successful upload, so it is weak evidence at best for whichever path it happens to hit.

checkout-wompi-redirect.name: Checkout creates order and opens payment
checkout-wompi-redirect.description: After POST /api/orders/ succeeds, frontend persists the per-order access capability before navigating to /payment. Wompi method submission remains owned by the payment flows.

orders-list-view.name: View my orders list
orders-list-view.description: Authenticated user navigates to /orders and sees their order cards with status badges

tracking-by-order-number.name: Track order by number
tracking-by-order-number.description: User enters an order number. Owner session or per-order capability loads the private timeline; missing or expired access opens email-code recovery, while unrelated request failure shows the generic tracking error.

tracking-auto-from-wompi.name: Auto-load tracking after Wompi redirect
tracking-auto-from-wompi.description: Tracking links use ?order= and #access. The browser consumes and removes the fragment before analytics, stores the capability and loads the timeline. An expired or absent capability opens email-code recovery.

auth-login-success.name: Successful sign-in and redirect
auth-login-success.description: Una cuenta activa y con correo verificado inicia sesión tras el CAPTCHA configurado y llega a sus pedidos o al backoffice según su rol.

auth-logout.name: Sign out
auth-logout.description: Authenticated user clicks Sign Out; tokens cleared from cookies; redirected to home or sign-in

auth-google-login.name: Google OAuth login
auth-google-login.description: User clicks Google button on sign-in page, completes OAuth, receives JWT, redirected to dashboard
knownGaps: Dead surface: Google OAuth sign-in was fully removed in commit e54a405 ('remove Google OAuth sign-in — not in client requirements'), backend AND frontend (views/auth.py google_login(), urls/auth.py path, sign-in/page.tsx GoogleLogin import/handler, settings GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID — all deleted). frontend/app/sign-in/page.tsx (read in full) has zero Google button/OAuth wiring; the only 'google' reference left is react-google-recaptcha (unrelated feature). The existing test (frontend/e2e/auth/auth-verification.spec.ts:67-95, 'should render Google sign-in entry point') is marked quality: allow-no-interaction and only optionally probes a selector that can never match, then asserts generic page structure — it is not evidence of anything Google-related.

auth-session-persistence.name: Session persistence across reload
auth-session-persistence.description: User with valid cookies navigates to a protected route and remains authenticated after reload

auth-registration-verify.name: Email verification after sign-up
auth-registration-verify.description: El visitante presenta código de registro y new_password válida; la verificación reemplaza la contraseña del pre-registro y abre la sesión hacia pedidos. Omitir o rechazar la contraseña no consume el código ni modifica la cuenta; se conservan bloqueo administrativo y consumo único.

app-dashboard-access.name: Dashboard access (authenticated)
app-dashboard-access.description: Authenticated user navigates to /dashboard and sees dashboard content without redirect
knownGaps: Dead surface: /dashboard does not exist anywhere in frontend/app (no such directory, no middleware.ts route). The app's real 'authenticated landing page' is /orders (sign-in redirects there for non-staff users, frontend/app/sign-in/page.tsx:45) guarded by useRequireAuth (frontend/app/orders/page.tsx:34). The one test tagged APP_DASHBOARD_ACCESS (frontend/e2e/app/dashboard.spec.ts:6-17) actually visits /orders and tests the UNAUTHENTICATED redirect case — the opposite of this flow's own description ('Authenticated user ... sees dashboard content without redirect') — duplicating auth-protected-redirect's territory while leaving the flow's real claim (authenticated user sees their real order data on /orders without redirect) completely untested. Recommend the Architect either retarget this flow at /orders (authenticated display) or fold it into the (separate-module) orders-list-view flow, which appears to own that exact territory.

payment-page-display.name: Payment page display
payment-page-display.description: Payment loads private totals through the per-order capability before showing payment methods. Missing or expired access opens email-code recovery; an unrelated failure keeps the retry state.

order-confirmed-display.name: Order confirmed page
order-confirmed-display.description: Confirmation reads private payment status before showing payment state. It clears the cart only after an approved authorized result. Missing or expired access opens email-code recovery; transient failure remains retryable.

review-display.name: Display peluch reviews
review-display.description: Visitor reaches a peluch detail through the catalog and sees approved public reviews. A guest receives an Iniciar sesión prompt instead of submission controls; an authenticated visitor whose GET response marks a review is_mine sees that review without another submission form.

review-submit.name: Submit peluch review
review-submit.description: Authenticated user with a delivered order fills rating and comment on peluch detail and submits POST /api/peluches/{slug}/reviews/. Public reviews omit author email; is_mine identifies the current user's own review.

backoffice-navigation.name: Navigate backoffice across viewport sizes
backoffice-navigation.description: Staff opens the drawer below 1024 px or uses the fixed sidebar at larger widths, navigates to the order list, dismisses the drawer outside its links and preserves usable navigation after rotation.

backoffice-login.name: Staff sign-in via /sign-in
backoffice-login.description: Staff submits credentials on /sign-in, receives JWT plus staff user data, and is redirected to /backoffice

backoffice-dashboard-display.name: Backoffice dashboard display
backoffice-dashboard-display.description: Authenticated staff sees /backoffice dashboard with analytics widgets (orders, revenue, top peluches)

backoffice-order-management.name: Backoffice order management
backoffice-order-management.description: Staff on /backoffice/pedidos views the initial paginated order table, its total order count, and status/tracking controls.

backoffice-peluch-list.name: Backoffice peluch list
backoffice-peluch-list.description: Staff views /backoffice/peluches with all peluches in a table; can navigate to detail or create new

backoffice-peluch-create.name: Backoffice create peluch
backoffice-peluch-create.description: Staff on /backoffice/peluches/nuevo fills PeluchForm and submits POST /api/peluches/

backoffice-peluch-edit.name: Backoffice edit peluch
backoffice-peluch-edit.description: Staff abre un peluche activo o borrador en /backoffice/peluches/[slug], conserva la casilla de publicación según is_active y guarda mediante PATCH /api/peluches/{slug}/; al guardar vuelve al listado. Guardar un borrador desmarcado no lo publica. El detalle de borradores permanece oculto para invitados y clientes.

backoffice-category-management.name: Backoffice category management
backoffice-category-management.description: Staff on /backoffice/categorias creates, edits, or deletes a category via categoryAdminService

backoffice-user-management.name: Backoffice user management
backoffice-user-management.description: El staff entra a Usuarios desde el menú y distingue Inactivo (bloqueado), Correo pendiente (activo sin verificar) y Activo (activo y verificado).

contact-page-display.name: Contact page display
contact-page-display.description: User navigates to /contact and sees contact form or contact information

about-page-display.name: About page display
about-page-display.description: User navigates to /about and sees the brand history/story content

terms-page-display.name: Terms and conditions display
terms-page-display.description: User navigates to /terms and sees the terms and conditions content

backoffice-site-configuration.name: Backoffice site configuration
backoffice-site-configuration.description: Staff edits the promo banner and uploads a hero image from /backoffice/configuracion; changes persist via /api/content/ endpoints

catalog-filter-by-category.name: Filter catalog by category
catalog-filter-by-category.description: User clicks a category label on /catalog; product list reloads with peluches matching only that category

catalog-sort-products.name: Sort catalog products
catalog-sort-products.description: User changes the sort dropdown on /catalog (e.g. price ascending); product list re-orders accordingly

auth-forgot-password-submit.name: Forgot password full reset
auth-forgot-password-submit.description: User requests a passcode by email, submits the code with a new password, and the password is reset

catalog-filter-by-size.name: Filter catalog by size
catalog-filter-by-size.description: User toggles a size pill in the /catalog sidebar; product list re-fetches with ?size=<slug> and shows only matching peluches

catalog-filter-by-price.name: Filter catalog by max price
catalog-filter-by-price.description: User adjusts the max-price slider on /catalog; product list re-fetches with ?max_price and excludes peluches above the threshold

catalog-filter-personalization.name: Filter catalog by huella personalization
catalog-filter-personalization.description: User toggles the 'con huella' filter on /catalog; product list re-fetches with ?has_huella=true and shows only peluches that support huella

catalog-pagination.name: Paginate catalog product grid
catalog-pagination.description: When /catalog returns more products than the page size (16 desktop / 12 mobile), pagination controls appear; user clicks page numbers or Siguiente/Anterior and the grid swaps to that page's products

orders-filter-by-status.name: Filter my orders by status
orders-filter-by-status.description: Authenticated user clicks a status filter button on /orders (Pendiente pago / Pago confirmado / En producción / Despachado / Entregado / Cancelado); list narrows to orders in that status

orders-search-by-number.name: Search my orders by number
orders-search-by-number.description: Authenticated user types into the 'Buscar por # pedido…' input on /orders; list filters in-memory by order_number or customer_name substring

auth-resend-verification-code.name: Resend sign-up verification code
auth-resend-verification-code.description: Una cuenta activa con correo pendiente puede reenviar su código de registro; la interfaz aplica el contador de 60 segundos.

auth-forgot-password-resend.name: Resend forgot-password code
auth-forgot-password-resend.description: During /forgot-password step 2 the user clicks 'Reenviar código' after the cooldown; POST /api/send_passcode/ is called again and the cooldown restarts

payment-card-submit.name: Pay with credit/debit card
payment-card-submit.description: User submits payment for an already authorized order. The process request carries its per-order capability; expired access switches to recovery. Existing method-specific validation and provider failures remain visible.

payment-nequi-submit.name: Pay with Nequi
payment-nequi-submit.description: User submits payment for an already authorized order. The process request carries its per-order capability; expired access switches to recovery. Existing method-specific validation and provider failures remain visible.

payment-pse-submit.name: Pay with PSE
payment-pse-submit.description: User submits payment for an already authorized order. The process request carries its per-order capability; expired access switches to recovery. Existing method-specific validation and provider failures remain visible.

payment-pse-legal-entity-nit.name: PSE legal entity requires NIT
payment-pse-legal-entity-nit.description: On PSE, when the user picks 'Jurídica' (legal entity), the document type selector is restricted to NIT only (natural person keeps CC/CE); the submitted request carries user_type=1 and user_legal_id_type=NIT

payment-bancolombia-submit.name: Pay with Bancolombia transfer
payment-bancolombia-submit.description: User submits payment for an already authorized order. The process request carries its per-order capability; expired access switches to recovery. Existing method-specific validation and provider failures remain visible.

backoffice-analytics-date-filter.name: Filter analytics dashboard by date range
backoffice-analytics-date-filter.description: Staff sets dateFrom/dateTo on /backoffice and clicks Aplicar; analyticsAdminService.getDashboard re-fetches and the KPI widgets and charts update for the new range

backoffice-analytics-export-csv.name: Export orders CSV from analytics
backoffice-analytics-export-csv.description: Staff exports the selected period as a CSV download; an export failure shows its existing error alert and restores the action.

backoffice-peluch-toggle-featured.name: Toggle peluch featured flag
backoffice-peluch-toggle-featured.description: Staff clicks the ⭐ button on a peluch row in /backoffice/peluches; PATCH /api/peluches/{slug}/ flips is_featured (capped at 4 featured peluches)

backoffice-peluch-delete.name: Delete peluch from backoffice
backoffice-peluch-delete.description: Staff clicks Eliminar on a peluch row in /backoffice/peluches and confirms; DELETE /api/peluches/{slug}/ removes the peluch and the row disappears

backoffice-peluch-bulk-category.name: Bulk assign category to peluches
backoffice-peluch-bulk-category.description: Staff selects multiple peluches via row checkboxes on /backoffice/peluches, picks a target category in the bulk action bar, and clicks Asignar; PATCH /api/peluches/bulk-category/ updates them all

backoffice-category-create.name: Create category in backoffice
backoffice-category-create.description: Staff clicks '+ Nueva categoría' on /backoffice/categorias, fills name/description/order/active/featured/image in the modal, and submits; POST /api/categories/ creates the category and the table re-renders

backoffice-category-edit.name: Edit category in backoffice
backoffice-category-edit.description: Staff clicks Editar on a category row, modifies fields in the modal, and saves; PATCH /api/categories/{id}/ persists the changes and the row updates

backoffice-category-delete.name: Delete category in backoffice
backoffice-category-delete.description: Staff clicks Eliminar on a category row in /backoffice/categorias and confirms; DELETE /api/categories/{id}/ removes it and the row disappears

backoffice-user-toggle-role.name: Toggle user role in backoffice
backoffice-user-toggle-role.description: Staff clicks 'Hacer admin' or 'Hacer cliente' on a user row in /backoffice/usuarios; PATCH /api/users/{id}/ updates role and is_staff, and the row label switches

backoffice-user-toggle-active.name: Toggle user active state
backoffice-user-toggle-active.description: El staff cambia únicamente is_active; la verificación de correo se muestra como dato de sólo lectura y se conserva al actualizar el estado.

backoffice-order-status-update.name: Update order status in backoffice
backoffice-order-status-update.description: Staff changes the per-row status select on /backoffice/pedidos; PATCH /api/orders/{number}/status/ persists the new state and a status-history entry is created

backoffice-order-tracking-update.name: Set order tracking number in backoffice
backoffice-order-tracking-update.description: Staff types a tracking number on a row in /backoffice/pedidos and clicks ✓; PATCH /api/orders/{number}/tracking/ saves carrier+guide and the field shows the new value

backoffice-promo-banner-save.name: Save promo banner from backoffice
backoffice-promo-banner-save.description: Staff toggles active, edits message and colors on /backoffice/configuracion, and clicks 'Guardar cinta'; PUT /api/content/promo_banner/ persists the JSON and button shows ✓ Guardado

backoffice-hero-image-upload.name: Upload hero image from backoffice
backoffice-hero-image-upload.description: Staff selects and uploads a hero image. Success updates preview and public hero; invalid input is reported as error. Storage or database failure reports an error while the previously published hero remains active.

backoffice-peluch-create-draft-on-color-.name: Draft peluch auto-created on first color image upload
backoffice-peluch-create-draft-on-color-.description: La primera foto de color en /backoffice/peluches/nuevo crea un borrador is_active=false. Staff puede continuar subiendo fotos y guardar mediante PATCH del mismo slug; la publicación final respeta la casilla elegida. Antes de subir fotos no se crea borrador; un rechazo conserva el estado visible de fallo de la imagen.

backoffice-peluch-color-upload-per-image.name: Per-image upload status with retry
backoffice-peluch-color-upload-per-image.description: Each color image upload on /backoffice/peluches/nuevo shows an individual status: uploading spinner → done checkmark on success, or failed badge with a per-image retry button on network error. A 'retry all failed' button appears when at least one image has failed. The Guardar/Crear button is DISABLED while any upload is pending or failed, and re-enables once all uploads resolve successfully.

backoffice-peluch-create-cancel-discards.name: Cancel discard draft peluch
backoffice-peluch-create-cancel-discards.description: Después de crear un borrador por la primera foto, staff pulsa Cancelar y confirma: DELETE /api/peluches/{slug}/ elimina el borrador inactivo y la interfaz regresa al listado. Si rechaza la confirmación, conserva el borrador y vuelve al listado.

backoffice-peluch-list-draft-badge.name: Draft badge on backoffice peluche list
backoffice-peluch-list-draft-badge.description: On /backoffice/peluches, any peluch with is_active=false is shown with a 'Borrador' badge next to its title. Active peluches (is_active=true) do not display the badge.

backoffice-order-filter.name: Filter backoffice orders by status
backoffice-order-filter.description: Staff opens Pedidos from the backoffice and selects a status filter. The change resets the list to page 1; GET /api/orders/list/?page=1&page_size=100&status=<status> replaces the table only when it is the current request, while superseded filter requests are aborted and cannot overwrite the latest result.

home-faq.name: Read home frequently asked questions
home-faq.description: User expands and collapses an existing home question at each project width; its answer stays readable within the page.

backoffice-order-pagination.name: Paginate backoffice orders
backoffice-order-pagination.description: Staff uses the enabled Página siguiente or Página anterior control on /backoffice/pedidos. GET /api/orders/list/?page=<n>&page_size=100 retains the selected status filter and replaces the rows with that page; unavailable directions are disabled. An active page request failure shows a visible loading error.

checkout-personalization-media-recovery.name: Recover inaccessible personalization media at checkout
checkout-personalization-media-recovery.description: When order creation rejects a huella or audio reference without uploader identity or signed upload capability, checkout identifies the affected line, keeps the cart intact, and links to personalization recovery. Reupload changes the file while preserving product, size, color and quantity.

order-access-recovery.name: Recover guest access to a private order
order-access-recovery.description: A visitor denied tracking, payment or confirmation enters the purchase email, receives a generic acknowledgement, submits a six-digit code, and receives a 30-day per-order capability. Wrong, expired, consumed, rate-limited or mismatched details show the same verification error without revealing whether an order/email exists.

purchase-form-controls-compact.name: Type purchase details at compact width without iOS zoom
purchase-form-controls-compact.description: At the compact 412x915 viewport the user types the huella name and the corazón phrase on /peluches/[slug] and the card holder, expiry and CVV on /payment. Every text control renders at 16 px or more so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus (RESPONSIVE_STANDARDS FORM-3), and the typed values stay in the controls.

admin-login-handoff.name: Signed administrative login handoff
admin-login-handoff.description: Un superusuario inicia «Login as this user» desde Django Admin; el navegador recibe un handoff firmado de 60 segundos en el fragmento de /admin-login y lo canjea mediante POST /api/admin-login/handoff/ por access, refresh y el usuario objetivo antes de ir a /. Tokens legacy en query o un handoff inválido, expirado o rechazado muestran «El enlace de acceso no es válido o ha expirado.» sin sustituir la sesión existente.

backoffice-peluch-color-photo-delete.name: Delete persisted peluch color photo
backoffice-peluch-color-photo-delete.description: En /backoffice/peluches/[slug], staff elimina una foto de color persistida mediante DELETE /api/peluches/{slug}/color-image/{colorSlug}/{photoId}/. Sólo una respuesta 204 quita la foto seleccionada; 404, 500 o fallo de red conservan todas las fotos persistidas y muestran «No pudimos confirmar la eliminación de la imagen. Intenta de nuevo.»
